reason: Generic opening breakout/retest did not show robust net advantage. Need incremental evidence, not parameter fitting to one winning day.
scope: Storage universe plus predeclared comparator set; keep unchanged losing baseline.
required_before_outcomes: Freeze timestamped event-source and inclusion/exclusion rules, including no-news controls.
Specify a signal latency, volume/relative-strength thresholds and matched controls before downloading evaluation outcomes.
Acquire point-in-time corporate actions/ticker mapping or explicitly exclude unresolved dates and preserve exclusion counts.
Freeze execution-cost and integer sizing; preserve all failed signals.
Use untouched future observations for promotion; this historical study cannot be relabeled unseen.
decision_policy: Do not enable a strategy from the current winner. No automatic capital replenishment. Research chooses and documents routine parameters without requiring user expertise.
